text:
Five power banks in the search results support Qi2.2 or Qi2 25W wireless charging. One of them is sold only in Japan.

| Power bank | Details | Link |
|---|---|---|
| **Anker MagGo 2 Pro** (10,000mAh) | $109.99, with active cooling fan, 45W USB-C in and out, and a smart display. It's a pre-order that ships Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. | [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910) |
| **Baseus PicoGo AM52** (10,000mAh) | Qi2.2-certified with a 45W USB-C port. It was $79.99 on Amazon US and $59.99 on Baseus's site at its February 2026 launch. Prices may have changed since. | [Notebookcheck article with launch details](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html) |
| **UGREEN MagFlow 25W** | The first Qi 2.2-certified power bank, announced July 2025. It was slated for Amazon and UGREEN's site, but the results don't give a price or a direct product page. | [UGREEN announcement](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html) |
| **ESR MagSlim** (10,000mAh) | 13.8mm thick, billed as the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank. It was previewed at CES 2026, and the release says it's on Amazon or ESR's site, but I can't confirm current availability or price. | [ESR announcement](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html) |
| **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K** (10,000mAh) | Semi-solid-state cell and a built-in USB-C cable with up to 35W output. It's priced at ¥8,980 and sold in Japan (Amazon.co.jp), so it's likely not practical for US buyers. | [CIO release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html) |

- **Phone compatibility:** Full 25W needs a Qi2.2-capable phone. Baseus lists the iPhone 16 and 17 series and the Pixel 10 Pro XL. Anker's page says its power bank works with the iPhone 13 through 17 (except the 16e) and is only compatible with Apple devices. Older iPhones will likely charge at lower speeds. Check each maker's compatibility list before buying.
- **Best fit:** For the best features, the Anker is the top pick, though it costs the most and ships in a few weeks. The Baseus is cheaper and was on the market earlier. If you want the thinnest option, look at the ESR.

I can't browse live, so confirm current prices and stock on each retailer's page.
